newsitem.title: USA: Blue Chip Value sets year-end distribution.
newsitem.headline: Blue Chip Value sets year-end distribution.

text.p: Blue Chip Value Fund Inc set a distribution of $1.26 per share on Tuesday.
Approximately $1.10 of the distribution amount is long-term capital gain, $0.12 short-term capital gain and $0.04 is net investment income.
The distribution is payable January 17 1997 to stockholders of record December 31 1996. The amount is in addition to $0.09 of net investment income previously paid in 1996.
Blue Chip Value Fund is a close-end diversified management investment company whose objective is to seek a high level of total return through investment in a diversified portfolio of common stocks.
